# English-speaking EU visitors planning a Dolomites trip

Travellers from Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Austria and Scandinavia who browse in English, typically 4–8 weeks before a hiking holiday in the Dolomites or Lake Garda. They search "what to pack for the Dolomites", "italian hiking boots" and "women's winter hiking boots" (for the snowshoe season). Average order value is 22% above the Italian segment, return rate higher because of sizing doubts. They buy the heritage story: Montebelluna, leather, Made in Italy where we can claim it. Relevant lines: Dolomiti, Nevaio, Vetta, Rifugio.
